# Effective source: AGOT/00_agot_special_buildings.txt
moat_cailin_02 = {


	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time

	type_icon = "icon_structure_moat_cailin.dds"

	can_construct_potential = { always = no }

	can_construct = { always = no }

	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "building_special_moat_cailin_02_mesh"
	}

	next_building = moat_cailin_03

	on_start = {
		county.holder = {
			add_character_flag = rebuilding_moat_cailin
			add_character_flag = started_rebuilding_moat_cailin
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.3000
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = constructor
			value = scope:character
		}
		title:c_ruins.holder = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = agot_rebuilding_ruins.1000
				months = { 11 37 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_cancelled = {
		root = { save_scope_as = province }
		county.holder = {
			add_character_flag = cancelled_cailin
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.9998
		}
	}

	on_complete = {
		county.holder = {
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.3001
		}
		remove_variable = constructor
	}

	is_enabled = {
		agot_generic_is_special_building_enabled = yes
	}

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_4_cost

	character_modifier = {
		domain_limit = 1
		monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.05
		legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	max_garrison = normal_building_max_garrison_tier_1

	province_modifier = {
		defender_holding_advantage = 10
		fort_level = 10
		stationed_archers_damage_mult = very_high_maa_damage_tier_3
		stationed_archers_toughness_mult = very_high_maa_toughness_tier_3
		supply_limit_mult = 1.75
	}
	county_modifier = {
		hostile_raid_time = 0.4
		travel_danger = -5
	}

	ai_value = { base = 0 }

	type = special

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_martial
	show_disabled = no
}

# Effective source: AGOT/00_agot_special_buildings.txt
ruins_harrenhal_02 = {

	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time
	effect_desc = {
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = { has_dlc_feature = tours_and_tournaments }
			desc = tournament_activity_cost_max_discount_effect_desc
		}
	}

	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "building_special_harrenhal_ruined_1_mesh"
	}

	type_icon = "icon_structure_harrenhal.dds"

	can_construct_potential = { always = no }

	is_enabled = {
		agot_generic_is_special_building_enabled = yes
	}

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.15
		dread_gain_mult = 0.25
		stress_gain_mult = 0.2
	}

	county_modifier = {
		levy_size = -0.08
		development_growth_factor = -0.08
	}

	max_garrison = 1500

	province_modifier = {
		defender_holding_advantage = 7
		fort_level = 7
		monthly_income = -2.1
	}

	next_building = ruins_harrenhal_03

	on_start = {
		county.holder = {
			add_character_flag = started_rebuilding_harrenhal
			add_character_flag = rebuilding_harrenhal
		}
		county.holder = {
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.4000 # Reconstructing event
		}

		title:c_ruins.holder = {
			trigger_event = {
				id = agot_rebuilding_ruins.9999
				years = 1
			}
		}

		set_variable = {
			name = constructor
			value = scope:character
		}
	}

	on_cancelled = {
		root = { save_scope_as = province }
		county.holder = {
			add_character_flag = cancelled_harrenhal
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.9998
		}
		remove_variable = constructor
	}

	on_complete = {
		county.holder = {
			trigger_event = agot_ruins.4001
		}
		remove_variable = constructor
	}

	ai_value = { base = 0 }

	type = special

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_martial
	show_disabled = no
	can_construct = { always = no }
}
